fieldValues.title: An agent's finished work cannot reach saving
fieldValues.statement: When I work with an agent on a document I loaded from GitHub, the agent can make and check its changes but has no way to bring them to a save. I must notice that the work is done, find Save myself and write the commit message, and the agent can only tell from `changes` that the work is still unsaved. Work an agent finishes sits unsaved until I remember it.
